b.title: individual-plus-group strip plots
b.query: How did two curricula change rule, memory and arbitration performance?
b.pitfall: Figure 4b in-context and arbitration have pre-registered contrasts; do not borrow star annotations without recalculating.

c.title: joint-learning index strip-and-estimate
c.query: Did the same individual retain both memory and rule strategies?
c.pitfall: DLI uses ((a-.1)/.9)*((b-.1)/.9). Negative empirical estimates may occur; original Figure 4c p=.036 and BF≈.969, not uniformly strong evidence.

e.title: two-ability training trajectory
e.query: Which strategy appeared first, then disappeared during later training?
e.pitfall: Line connects actual checkpoint means in chronological order. Never infer that a direct straight trajectory is measured if checkpoints were not saved.
